places_note: Approach a landmark, or jump straight to a district.
inspector_toggle_hint: Collapse or expand the place study panel
inspector_empty: Choose a place from the list or click a visible landmark.
cutaway_note: Inspection cutaway: the covering ground and roof are hidden to expose this underground reservoir.
interior_note: Architectural inspection · 8 m/s detail speed. Tab mouse look; WASD move, Q/E descend/rise. Your travel speed returns when you leave.
editor_note: Your additions form a separate local variant. Historical architecture stays in place.
count_template: %d additions · separate from the historical baseline
saved: Creative variant saved in the study's own user folder.
save_error: The creative variant could not be saved. Check the study user folder's available space and permissions.
load_missing: There is no saved creative variant in this study's user folder yet.
load_error: The saved file is not a valid variant for this city. The current design was retained.
load_clamped: Creative variant loaded; rotations and sizes were constrained to this study's limits.
placement_limit: This variant has reached its limit of 500 additions. Delete an addition before placing another.
placed: Addition placed. Rotate, resize or save it in the creative workshop.
pick_addition: Click an addition in the scene to select it.
placement_active: Click clear terrain to place the selected kit. Escape leaves placement mode.
placement_outside: Choose visible land inside the study boundary.
cleared: Creative additions cleared. Undo restores the previous design.
ready: City assembled. Choose a place or explore the skyline.
camera_view: City inspection view · orbit, pan and zoom to explore.
data_error: The city data could not be loaded. Reopen the complete study package.
screenshot_error: The screenshot could not be saved to this study's user folder.
help_orbit: Right-drag orbit · middle-drag pan · wheel / pinch zoom · Shift-wheel faster · double-click terrain to approach · Home whole city · H panels
help_fly: Tab mouse look · WASD move · Q/E descend/rise · wheel or [ / ] speed · Shift ×4 · Escape release · Home whole city · H panels
help_walk: Tab mouse look · WASD walk · Shift run · Escape release · district menu jump · Home whole city · H panels
walk_note: Walking follows terrain and obstacles. Pantokrator has detailed interiors and stairs; use its walking starts for the completed route.
district_hint: Move directly to an authoring district. Free flight stays in free flight; Escape releases the mouse.
district_arrival: %s · district view. Tab resumes free flight.
jump_arrival: Location approached. Tab resumes free flight; Home shows the whole city.
speed_hint: Choose your travel speed. In free flight, wheel or [ / ] changes this setting. Shift gives a temporary ×4 boost. Walking stays at walking speed.
speed_status: Flight speed %d m/s · hold Shift for %d m/s
neighborhood_note: Pantokrator lanes and courts · interpretive neighborhood, circa 1200. Choose a walking start below the district menu.
neighborhood_walk_hint: Tab to walk · WASD · Shift to hurry · Escape releases mouse · H hides panels. Doors and passages lead into courts.
neighborhood_sources: Evidence: Pantokrator typikon (1136), §§19, 43, 45, 47; Sanders, Corinth (regional analogy). Exact parcels and furnishings are interpretive.
loaded_legacy_neighborhood: Design loaded at its saved coordinates. The v0.2 neighborhood fabric is shown for additions in the revised area; uncheck its option to compare.
